description: Prepare a direct extension for an unvoted VeToken or an atomic claim-and-extend call when current_pool_key identifies an active vote, so pending voter fees are preserved. Extending moves the stake to a later end time and clears its vote — that is why the claim is compounded into the same call. A stake's end time only ever moves later, here and everywhere else in Ve33. No NFT is burned and no stake leaves the wallet; re-vote afterwards with prepare_ve33_vote. max_duration=true must be the user's explicit choice.

chain_id.description: With ve_token, from get_ve33_allocations (STONX: 4663), not the wallet's chain

current_pool_key.description: Active pool key when voted; the MCP claims fees atomically before extension. Omit only for an unvoted VeToken. PoolKey {token0, token1, config} or {token0, token1, fee, tick_spacing, extension, stableswap_params?}, as read from the pool or vote

name: prepare_ve33_extend
title: Prepare a ve-token extension
